programme.title: Mera Karam Mera Dharam
programme.desc: Ajay, a businessman, provides funds to Sarjuprasad to develop his hometown. When he learns that the money has been misappropriated by Sarjuprasad, he resolves to set things right.

programme.title: Ranbanka
programme.desc: Rahul, an ordinary engineer, comes to Mathura with his wife and son. However, when a gangster gets attracted to his wife and forces her to marry him, he tries to find a way to stop his advances.

programme.title: Shivam
programme.desc: When Nalla and Aras get stranded at the airport, Aras tries to keep away from the man with a deformity. However, while forcefully accompanying each other to Chennai, they form an unexpected bond.

programme.title: Blood Relation
programme.desc: Full of action and drama.

programme.title: Buniyad
programme.desc: he storyline involves a vengeful ex-convict who attempts to start a new life and deals with a "wicked woman" who tries to destroy the lives of those around him.

programme.title: Teri Kasam
programme.desc: Dolly, a rich and spoilt woman, falls for Tony, a poor musician, and marries him. However, her arrogance begins to create problems in their marital life.

programme.title: 15th August
programme.desc: Nagpal kills Chaudhry and his son, Ram, a military officer. Chaudhry's second son, Vikram, vows to destroy Nagpal who is all set to become the Chief Minister on the upcoming Indian Independence Day.

programme.title: Apartment
programme.desc: Preeti, an air hostess, is tired of her unfaithful boyfriend and decides to throw him out of the house. To share the rent, she finds a roommate who appears to be a simple girl but has her own agenda.

programme.title: Jaan Se Pyaara
programme.desc: Inspector Jai arrests Guman only to release him after he threatens to destroy the city. Later, Jai's brother, who has a cognitive disability, gets abducted in return for a mysterious bag.

programme.title: China Gate
programme.desc: Colonel Puri requests his former fellow army officers court-martialed in disgrace to redeem themselves by rescuing a village from Jageera, an evil bandit.

programme.title: Papi Gudia
programme.desc: A criminal uses a possessed doll to lure children and kill them. His latest target is Raju, the young brother of a dancer, who soon becomes the main suspect in a series of murders.

programme.title: Zindagi Gulzar Hai
programme.desc: Kashaf, a young woman raised by a single mother, faces a lot of class and gender bias while growing up. However, her life turns around when she meets Zaroon in college.

programme.title: Kehte Hain Muzko Raaja
programme.desc: Action Movie.

programme.title: Barah Aana
programme.desc: Three men accidentally stumble into the world of crime when they start kidnapping for small ransoms in order to improve their lifestyles. However, they soon realise that it is not a bad business.

programme.title: Jigri Dost
programme.desc: Shobha prepares to marry an advocate named Anand as arranged by her father. However, she secretly follows him one day and is shocked to see him in the arms of another woman.

programme.title: Katilon Ke Kaatil
programme.desc: A wealthy widow meets Munna and Ajit and assumes them to be her estranged sons. She takes them into her house, unaware that their intentions are to loot her entire wealth.

programme.title: Devta
programme.desc: Balram, a rogue, who works for crime lord Bajrang decides to kill inspector Rakesh for sending him to prison. However, he changes his mind when he learns a secret about Rakesh.

programme.title: Mafia Raaj
programme.desc: An honest police officer has a mission to wipe out a mafia group. But in the process, he is forced to sacrifice not only his father but also his sister.

programme.title: Haisiyat
programme.desc: Union leader Ram is also married to his boss. When there is a conflict between the management and the workers, Ram must decide if his duty lies towards his wife or towards his union and the workers.

programme.title: Dharmyudh
programme.desc: A successful man tries to reconnect with his old teacher only to find out that she is in deep trouble. Upon learning this, he decides to do everything he can to save her.

programme.title: Khel Khilari Ka
programme.desc: Ajit swears revenge after witnessing his family's murder by three goons. Years later he becomes a wealthy crime lord, but he still thirsts for revenge.

Bing's book is first, but when Coco tries to bring the Rainbow Fairy Mice into the story, Bing is frustrated; that's not how it goes! But Flop shows Bing how they can combine the two tales together.

programme.title: Yakka Dee
programme.desc: S3 E7 — Yo-yoDee encourages a friend to say 'yo-yo' and we go on a whirlwind word adventure. We see all sorts of yo-yos, some spotty yo-yos, a stripy yo-yo, an up and down yo-yo, a rocking yo-yo and even a peepo yo-yo.

programme.title: Tralala
programme.desc: S1 E14 — Wrong Way UpTralala and Batty try to have a sleepover during the day.

programme.title: MaeBee
programme.desc: S1 E5 — Mae, Bee and the Acorn ExchangeIt's Mae and Bee's first Acorn Exchange Day, but Mae's attempts to teach Little Acorn the gnomish way test Mae's mighty patience to the limit!

programme.title: Kiri and Lou
programme.desc: S2 E20 — Who Am I?Kiri is upset when she finds some strangers sitting on Rockaroonie.

programme.title: Twirlywoos
programme.desc: S3 E6 — More About In and OutA man in a restaurant is looking at his mobile phone. He puts it in his briefcase, but it rings again. The Twirlywoos pass the phone to the man every time it rings.

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S12 E2 — We're All Friends: On the RiverDown on the river, Justin and his friends learn to paddle a bell boat and have a sing-song. Meanwhile, Mr Tumble joins Fisherman Tumble by the water as they go duck spotting.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E46 — ThreeLaa-Laa has fun counting to three. 1, 2, 3 rabbits, 1, 2, 3 flowers and 1, 2, 3 trees. Laa-Laa even counts three Teletubbies, Tinky Winky, Dipsy and Po.

programme.title: The Baby Club
programme.desc: S3 E3 — BedtimeGiovanna and Baby Bear welcome babies Reau, Alfie, Charlie, Ollie, Otis, River and their grown-ups to The Baby Club. Inside Giovanna's bag is a night light, and all the parents and babies have toys that could be used as part of a bedtime routine.

programme.title: I Spy, You Spy
programme.desc: S1 E7 — PicnicElsie joins her friend Ellie-Mai in the park for a picnic and a game of I Spy.

programme.title: Maddie and Triggs
programme.desc: S1 E29 — Where In The WorldMaddie and Triggs choose their favourite postcards from Uncle George for the fridge.

programme.title: Monster Makes
programme.desc: S1 E18 — Out of this World!No, Rebecca isn't wearing a box on her head - she's dressed as an astronaut! This gives Murphy an idea. He's going to help Rebecca discover alien life by creating an alien out of a sock. The Mini Monsters are making skyscapes, Rebecca's royal relative is looking for something, and the final mega monster make is another space-inspired creation. The Recycling Express and the Tiny Helpers support Rebecca and Murphy as they reach for the stars.

programme.title: Raa Raa the Noisy Lion
programme.desc: S3 E4 — Raa Raa and the Zippy Zip WireZebby is too scared to go down the zip wire and everyone chanting loudly at her makes matters worse. Raa Raa realises the noise is putting her off and if everyone is quiet it might help Zebby.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S1 E2 — HospitalNurse Bingo gives Dad an x-ray which reveals he has a cat in his tummy and Dr Bluey has to operate immediately.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E38 — The Bridge BadgeMeet Duggee, a big lovable dog who runs a club for pre-schoolers that inspires children to have fun, be energetic, and - most of all - to do things!

programme.title: Teeny Tiny Creatures
programme.desc: S1 E3 — Ferne and Rory: WoodliceHimmat wants to learn about wonderful woodlice. Rory and his son Sandy go hunting for woodlice in the park and build a bug hotel, while Ferne learns that woodlice are crustaceans just like crayfish.

programme.title: My First Festivals
programme.desc: S2 E9 — ThanksgivingFollowing Caleb and his family as they learn about and celebrate the American festival of Thanksgiving. Caleb and his family play American football in the garden, and then Captain Caleb goes out on a yacht.

programme.title: Big Cook Little Cook
programme.desc: S4 E5 — Peanut the ParrotJen finds a message in a bottle in the washing up and Small believes it's from Pirate Tiny Spoon. While on a treasure hunt, they get a visit from Peanut the Parrot and make her a treasure pie recipe.

programme.title: Dog Squad
programme.desc: S1 E9 — Mission: Sunflower AdventureTinks is a disability assistance dog for her owner, Charli, who has a condition that makes it painful for her to pick things up or to push and pull things. Tinks uses her super fetch skills to help Charli every day. The smallest of the Dog Squad gang, Tinks is a little Lhasa Apso with lots of big dog energy. Tinks and Charli are planting some seeds at the allotments.

programme.title: Go Wild
programme.desc: S2 E39 — Aneeshwar and Lizzie: Honeybee and Naked Mole RatAneeshwar and Lizzie meet honeybees and naked mole rats.

programme.title: What's on Your Head?
programme.desc: S1 E4 — TurbanRajvatan, who is a Sikh, tells us all about his terrific turban and what it means for him to wear it.

programme.title: Waffle's After School Club
programme.desc: S1 E1 — Waffle's HooplaIt's Waffle's first ever after-school club, and Waffle is tentative about the new experience until class friends Daisy and Cole help him join in with an impromptu hoop hunt.

programme.title: Puffin Rock
programme.desc: S1 E20 — Silky's SlideA wild storm leaves puffin rock in a bit of a mess. As Oona and Baba prepare to help clean it up, they discover that the weather and high tides have left Silky stranded on the cliff with no way back to sea and her family.

programme.title: Yukee
programme.desc: S1 E43 — Yukee's First Camp OutYukee and TapTap spend the night in a tent and are surprised to meet some beautiful, musical fireflies.

programme.title: Lu & the Bally Bunch
programme.desc: S1 — Wiggling and FlappingLu, Elodie, Declan, Gus, Biba and Barnaby go out on a snowy day to make snow bugs, but Elodie gets upset when Lu makes an incorrect assumption.

programme.title: Piggy Builders
programme.desc: S1 E52 — Bunny Builders SchoolThree bunnies want to become builders, so the Piggies start teaching them. Though experts at building, the Piggies aren't great teachers. The lessons quickly get messy and chaotic!

programme.title: Numberblocks
programme.desc: S3 E9 — Peekaboo!The number friends take turns hiding behind each other in a song and dance all about bigger and smaller. Learn about comparing numbers with the Numberblocks.

programme.title: Alphablocks
programme.desc: S2 E26 — The Cat Sat on the MatThe Alphablocks are singing, Rat and Bat are dancing, but Cat just won't get up off the mat. Not even for a magic hat. What is Cat playing at?

programme.title: Something Special
programme.desc: S14 E15 — We're All Friends: SkiingJustin and his friend have fun at the ski slope.

programme.title: Teletubbies
programme.desc: S2 E53 — KingIn Teletubbyland, Dipsy is King. Tinky Winky delivers Tubby Custard and Tubby Toast to King Dipsy, whatever King Dipsy wants. Luckily for Tinky Winky they soon swap places.

programme.title: Ranger Hamza's Eco Quest
programme.desc: S1 E14 — WoodpeckerRanger Hamza and the Ramblers discover how woodpeckers play such an important role in the environment. They find out that woodpeckers love to eat insects, which helps keep nature in balance, and that some other birds recycle old woodpecker nests to make their own ones. On the way, they try making some woodpecker sounds and discover that green woodpeckers use their long tongues to find ants to eat.

programme.title: Maddie's Do You Know?
programme.desc: Posting a Letter and Colouring PencilsMaddie is sending a letter in the post to the CBeebies House. She finds out how posting a letter works, as she follows the letter's journey.

programme.title: Grace's Amazing Machines
programme.desc: S2 E7 — Water MachinesSeries for young children that celebrates many different kinds of amazing machines. In this episode, Grace shows off three incredible machines that can go on water!

programme.title: Time for School
programme.desc: S4 E3 — Jud and Lucas Become FriendsIt's a new day, and Mrs Farrell is checking in with all the children to see how they are. Lucas tells her he is looking for more friends to play with, and there are lots of volunteers. Isla, Otto and Jud bake some delicious tiger ginger biscuits, using coloured icing for roar-some decorations. At playtime, Jud asks if she can play with Lucas, and they have a fun-filled game of chase. The day ends with carpet-time, and Lucas is happy with his new-found friends.

programme.title: Octonauts
programme.desc: S3 E2 — Water BearsThe Octonauts venture into a dangerous red-hot lava tube to rescue a teeny tiny water bear who doesn't seem to mind the heat at all!

programme.title: Peter Rabbit
programme.desc: S1 — The Tale of Nutkin on the RunWhen Squirrel Nutkin angers Old Brown by taking his glasses, it's up to Peter and his friends to put things right.

programme.title: Hey Duggee
programme.desc: S3 E16 — The Philosophy BadgeTino the artistic mouse is trying to paint a picture of Duggee but cannot get it right, which infuriates him no end. As he tells the Squirrels: seeking perfection is his whole philosophy! The squirrels don't know what that is, so Duggee explains: a philosophy is a set of rules that you live by. But the rules exist in your head - it's about how you think, not just what you think about.

programme.title: Piripenguins
programme.desc: S1 E38 — Rumble on the RadioBrinicle invites Pancake onto his radio show but, to his friend's annoyance, his accidental burps prove a hit. Pancake discovers that fame as 'burping guy' has its downsides.

programme.title: Supertato
programme.desc: S2 E19 — Double TroubleSupertato and Carrot go looking for ice and think Evil Pea has become kind by giving them some. They soon realise it is not Evil Pea that was in that ice block.

programme.title: Weasy Family
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Mission BirthdayExcitement fills the air because today is Weasy's special day. The ducklings are fluttering about, incredibly busy preparing a surprise birthday party to make it a truly memorable occasion.

programme.title: Mojo Swoptops
programme.desc: S1 E2 — Mojo RocksA rock slide blocks Ted the bus and his passengers in a mountain pass. Mojo's mighty dozer top will make short work of those rocks if Mojo and Bo can work together.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E1 — PerfectBluey's Father's Day card has to be perfect, but she can't decide what to draw. Mum reminds her about all the fun times she has had with Dad.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E3 — FeatherwandBluey and Mum are off to Chloe's party and Bingo isn't invited. When a passing cockatoo drops a feather, Bingo has an idea for a new game called 'Featherwand', and when she waves her Featherwand she can make objects impossibly heavy.

programme.title: Zog
programme.desc: S1 E31 — Speedy DragonWhen an outbreak of lupine lurgy causes the doctors' patients to howl like wolves, Zog races to treat as many creatures as he can, with chaotic results.

programme.title: Balamory
programme.desc: S2 E4 — Deep Sea AdventureAfter diving in Balamory Bay, PC Plum dreams of taking the nursery children underwater.

programme.title: Waffle the Wonder Dog

Gramps is one of the first to arrive with Muckypups and Thor, two pugs he's dog-sitting for the day, and AJ and Anaya have also brought their pets, a gecko called Leo and three fish, Dipper, Dapper and Dopper. Simon and Waffle put on a show for their excited guests, performing the amazing tricks Waffle has mastered. Next to arrive is Mr. Meagre and his talking parrot, Pickles.

programme.title: Rafi the Wishing Wizard
programme.desc: S1 E34 — The Lights Out WishRafi wishes for all the lights to go out so she can see a meteor shower!

programme.title: JoJo & Gran Gran
programme.desc: S1 E31 — Autumn: It's Time for a Birthday PartyWhen JoJo learns that Jared was too busy to have a birthday party, Gran Gran has a Gran Gran Plan to throw Jared a surprise belated birthday party. But keeping it a surprise is harder than they thought.

programme.title: Sarah & Duck
programme.desc: S1 E27 — World Bread DayWhen there's a bread festival in the park, Sarah and Duck find themselves part of an exciting treasure hunt.

programme.title: Clangers
programme.desc: S2 E18 — The Memory BoxWhile fishing in the music boat, Tiny and Small catch a strange box. It turns out to be the memory box Mother made when she was a little girl. And this gives them an idea.

programme.title: BeddyByes
programme.desc: S1 E4 — Jumpy PlanetBaBa wants to jump, like MeMo. Together they find a fun way to help BaBa bounce.

programme.title: In the Night Garden
programme.desc: S2 E16 — Windy Day in the GardenUpsy Daisy and Igglepiggle are going for a walk in the garden, and it is a very windy day. The trees are blowing side to side, Igglepiggle's blanket gets blown up and up into the air, and the Tombliboos are outside their house and now their trousers have been blown off the line.

programme.title: Cbeebies Bedtime Stories
programme.desc: S2026Jarvis Cocker reads a musical story about a little wombat with a big talent.

Hungry wolves are struggling to bring down their elk prey in the unusually shallow snow. For great grey owls, it is the iciness of the snow that is hampering their hunts.

programme.title: Arena
programme.desc: Dickens on FilmFrom the magical films of the silent era to the celebrated work of director David Lean and high definition television, this documentary revisits films and interviews from the archive to answer the question of why Dickens's novels have inspired so many hundreds of adaptations on screen.

programme.desc: S1 E29 — Flap Away HomeWhen a lost bird takes a liking to Bo, Mojo must fly it home. However, the journey is stormy, and Bo finds himself needing to take flight as well.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S3 E15 — ExplorersWhile waiting to be picked up from school, Jack plays at being a sailor trying to find his way back home to Australia. Jack's dad, however, has got lost en route to collect him.

programme.title: Bluey
programme.desc: S2 E4 — SquashWhen Dad and Uncle Stripe play a game of squash, Bluey and Bingo pretend that they are in control of their every move. Bingo proves that big siblings don't always beat little siblings.

Fantasy adventure, starring Logan Lerman, Pierce Brosnan, Brandon T Jackson, Alexandra Daddario, Jake Abel, Sean Bean and Steve Coogan.

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About Tha

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About Tha

programme.title: The Cat in the Hat Knows a Lot About Tha

programme.desc: E5Exploring the machines that hide in the shadows, capturing, transmitting and analysing vital combat information.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E6In 1961, Soviet T-54 tanks and American M-48 Patton tanks face off at Checkpoint Charlie in Berlin.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E5This episode celebrates the bravery and innovation of those who took to the skies. Jason and Bruce explore the Caterpillar Club badge, awarded to aircrew who survived by parachuting from stricken aircraft.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E6The shadowy world of special operations is brought vividly to life in this episode. Jason and Bruce handle Rusty Firmin’s SAS respirator, worn during the dramatic Iranian Embassy Siege of 1980.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E3Exploring how the Axis Powers' ruthless, brutal occupation, and exploitation of other countries contributed to their demise.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E5The war enters its third year with battlefields in Eastern Europe, North Africa and the Asia/Pacific. The Battle of Midway, a battle with irreversible consequences, is a victory for the USA.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E6From the Indian border in Burma to China, which has been at war with Japan since 1937, the war grows more savage. In Europe, despite having less resources than when he first made the attempt, Hitler renews his assault on the Soviet Union.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E3Ordinary objects can become extraordinary when pulled from the battlefield. In this episode, Jason and Bruce explore a regimental band cornet, owned by a band member who tragically died during the infamous Battle of Isandlwana.

programme.title: Battle Treasures With Foxy And Bruce
programme.desc: E4Escape and survival in war often came down to ingenuity and courage. Jason and Bruce showcase miniature escape compasses, cunningly disguised inside RAF tunic buttons and belt buckles to help downed airmen find their way home.

programme.title: How To Lose A War
programme.desc: E2Exploring how the seeds of Japan's defeat in 1945 were sown a decade earlier with the occupation of Manchuria in China.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E3The United Kingdom is isolated as German forces occupy Europe. 17,000 Trains carry German armies towards the Soviet Union. With Operation Barbarossa Hitler launches Vernichtungskrieg, a war of annihilation.

programme.title: Hell On Earth: WWII
programme.desc: E4After Pearl Harbour and their triumphant sweep across South-East Asia, Japanese armies celebrate their victory. But Japanese confidence is shaken four months later at the Battle of the Coral Sea.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3The Republic P-47 Thunderbolt, a Second World War fighter aircraft produced by the American company Republic Aviation from 1941 until 1945. It was considered a successful high-altitude fighter and also served as the foremost US fighter-bomber in the ground-attack role.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4The Yakovlev Yak-3, a Second World War Soviet fighter that was regarded for its performance at low altitudes and its agility. It was one of the most successful Soviet aircraft designs of the war.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8The Leopard 2 is probably the best all-around Main Battle Tank today, combining great mobility, a superior gun and excellent protection.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E7We tell the story of two rescues that ended in tragedy – the sinking of the hospital ship Britannic, and the Lancastria, rescuing soldiers and civilians from France in 1940. In the 19th century, USS Constellation chased down slave ships.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E8Ships don't have to be large to change the course of history. The Smithsonian has a small 1776 wooden gunboat, built to stop a British invasion and two Japanese midget submarines were part of the attack on Pearl Harbour.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E1Near the Czech border, a secret German site, "The Giant," tests The Bell, powered by Serum 525, turning all who touch it into rotting living zombies.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E21942 and Hitler has the totally barking idea of using educated dogs to do a soldier's job. The Nazi leader wants to create fearsome canines to help him win the Second World War.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E1During WWII, the French Resistance seeks aid from SOE. Led by Vera Atkins, Odette Sansom and Noor Inayat Khan fight the Nazis, risking it all for victory.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E2Vera enlists Violette Szabo and Yvonne Baseden. With circuits failing and Noor at risk, treachery allegations harm preparations for the Allied invasion.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E1The F15 Eagle immediately turned the tide of the first Gulf War to prove its greatness. Our immaculately restored MiG Killer was involved in one of the most bizarre combat incidents during that conflict, and has survived to tell the tale.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E2The mighty Flying Fortress takes to the air as we examine the background and development of one of WWIIs most iconic bombers. Serving with both the USAAF and the RAF, we see it in action and fly a surfing example.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E7A look at the military engineering used as US and South Vietnamese forces attempt to overcome North Vietnam and the Viet Cong.

programme.title: Combat Machines
programme.desc: E8A look at the origins of the Arms Race between the USA and the Soviet Union, and the nuclear weapons that ended WWII.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E3With Allied victories and the liberation of Paris following D-Day, Vera is in a race against time to locate her missing agents.

programme.title: The Lost Women Spies
programme.desc: E4Armed with evidence from Odette, Vera intensifies her search at Karlsruhe prison and Ravensbruck, facing hurdles to uncover crucial results in Germany.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E1On September 1, 1939, Germany’s invasion of Poland throws the world into war. No longer a European affair, the conflict spreads: in the Pacific, Japan—at war with China since 1937—accelerates its imperial ambitions.

programme.title: The Sound And The Fury
programme.desc: E2In the East, Hitler launches Operation Barbarossa and invades the Soviet Union, reaching the outskirts of Moscow. But winter and Soviet resistance break his momentum. The Red Army, boosted by relentless propaganda, put up a fierce fight.

programme.desc: E3Adolf Hitler's father was a violent, abusive man. His mother doted on her young son. This episode delves deep into the psychology of Hitler as the narcissistic child who grew into a malignant psychopath full of rage and deep hatred.

programme.title: Hitler's Secret Sex Life
programme.desc: E4Four women who had the misfortune to be pursued by Hitler saw only one way out of the relationship. His beloved niece took her own life and a German film star he was seeing fell from a balcony to her death.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E5The Hawker Hurricane was the first RAF aircraft to fly over 300mph. Over half of every enemy aeroplane destroyed in the Battle of Britain was by a Hurricane, not a Spitfire.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E6The McDonnell Douglas F-4 Phantom II. Regarded as one of the most important aircraft of the Cold War. It was a major part of the United States Air Force, Navy and Marine Corps, and was also used by many other countries.

programme.title: Combat Trains
programme.desc: E1Nazi Germany boasted that its locomotives were faster and more innovative. This programme examines that claim by looking at these ‘flying trains’.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E9Learn about life on a Tudor ship from objects found on the Mary Rose, while on HMS Victory discover the battle-winning tactics of Admiral Nelson.

programme.title: Combat Ships
programme.desc: E10In 1939, the German raider Atlantis was equipped with fake funnels and her sailors dressed as women pushing prams to fool Allied merchant ships. We also look at how merchant ships were painted with bizarre shapes to fool U-boats.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E3In 1914, Russian designer Nikolay Lebedenko decided to engineer a solution to the problem of trench warfare with an armoured vehicle with huge wheels that could move over any terrain.

programme.title: World War Weird
programme.desc: E4Discover the true story of a German Luftwaffe pilot in World War II who risked his own life to save the crew of an American B-17 bomber.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E3In 2008, nearly 850 people are killed in the Russo-Georgian War. How did it erupt and what is the current relationship between the two nations?

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered
programme.desc: E4Soviet troops withdraw from Afghanistan in 1989 after fighting a force funded by the US. Should the US be blamed for the rise of Islamic terrorism.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E3Often called 'the forgotten bomber', the mighty North American twin delivered the first blow in the fight back against Japan, in one of the most daring and audacious raids of all time.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft
programme.desc: E4Cruelly called 'the packing case the B17 came in,' the Liberator more than proved its worth over Europe and the Pacific, patterning the B17 to deliver a blow to the axis powers in WWII however it wasn't simply a bomb delivery system.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E1Two iconic machines of World War II - the Spitfire symbolised British hope and resistance, while the Tiger tank embodied German power.

programme.title: Iconic Combat Machines
programme.desc: E2The Vietnam war changed aerial warfare in more ways than one. The Phantom became the first true fighter bomber of the modern era.

programme.title: Secret Wars Uncovered

programme.desc: E8After the Cuban revolution, Fidel Castro looked to exert his influence in Venezuela. Is Cuba still in charge of Venezuela's future?

programme.desc: E1The Avro Lancaster is the legendary British heavy bomber that carved its place in history with Bomber Command during World War 2. That conflict saw over seven thousand of these iconic aircraft come off the production line.

programme.title: History's Greatest Aircraft

programme.title: Kesari
programme.desc: Based on an incredible true story of the Battle of Saragarhi in which an army of 21 Sikhs fought against 10,000 Afghans in 1897.

programme.title: Koi... Mil Gaya
programme.desc: Scientist contacts aliens but faces disbelief. An accident harms his unborn son, Rohit, who later befriends Nisha. They find the alien Jadoo, leading to chaos

programme.title: Aatma - Feel It Around You
programme.desc: A single mother fights against the supernatural in order to hold on to her daughter. Stars: Jaideep Ahlawat, Bipasha Basu, Padam Bhola. Director: Suparn Verma. .

programme.title: Article 15
programme.desc: A police detective investigates the abduction of two girls in a village that still practices caste discrimination. Crime drama, starring Ayushmann Khurrana and Nassar

programme.title: Om Jai Jagadish
programme.desc: Three brothers put aside their differences to join forces and save their ancestral home from being auctioned, resolving their family's legacy and their own personal issues.

programme.title: Tumsa Nahin Dekha
programme.desc: Daksh, a millionaire, sees Jia, a stripper, on a street and falls madly in love with her. However, if he does not marry Anahita, he stands to lose his inheritance

programme.title: Ghayal
programme.desc: Ajay, wrongfully framed by Balwant Rai, teams up with fellow convicts for a thrilling quest for revenge. Together, they plot to reclaim his life and settle the score.

programme.title: Narsimha
programme.desc: A powerful divine being rises to stop a cruel ruler and protect a faithful child. The story highlights courage, justice, and the strength of true belief

programme.title: Don
programme.desc: A man is recruited to masquerade as the Don, the leader of an international gang of smugglers. Indian Hindi-language action thriller, starring Shah Rukh Khan

programme.title: The Kerala Story 2 Goes Beyond
programme.desc: Three women choose love over family expectations, but their dreams soon turn into hardship. Their journeys reveal how trust can become a path to loss and control.

programme.title: Antim: The Final Truth
programme.desc: A farmer's son is forced to leave the village and move to the city, where he becomes a gangster and crosses paths with a cop. Indian Hindi-language action, starring Salman Khan

programme.title: Vijaypath
programme.desc: When a notorious criminal is apprehended by an industrious inspector and subsequently convicted by the officer's brother, he seeks the ultimate revenge against the family.

programme.title: Crook
programme.desc: Corrupt police and racially motivated attacks against Indian students complicate a re-located crook's life in Australia

programme.title: Bharat
programme.desc: Drama charting a man's life in parallel with the birth and growth of the Indian nation. Starring Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif, Jackie Shroff, Disha Patani, Sunil Grover and Tabu

programme.title: Uunchai

programme.title: Simpsons
programme.desc: Som vinder af 2019 Emmy® Award-prisen for fremragende, animeret program fortsætter The Simpsons med at vække genklang hos seere for uærbødigt at lave sjov med alt og alle. Med dens yderliggående humor og herlige vid har serien gjort et uudsletteligt indtryk på amerikansk popkultur, og dets familiemedlemmer - Homer (Dan Castellaneta), Marge (Julie Kavner), Bart (Nancy Cartwright), Lisa (Yeardley Smith) og Maggie - er tv-ikoner. Som den længst kørende, nedskrevne serie i tv-historien har den Emmy® Award-, Annie Award- og Peabody Award-vindende, animerede komedie overgået Gunsmokes rekord for flest episoder af en nedskrevet, primetime tv-serie. The Simpsons er en Gracie Films produktion i samarbejde med 20th Century Fox Television. Serien blev skabt af Matt Groening og udviklet af James L. Brooks, Matt Groening og Sam Simon. James L. programme.desc: Vor 150 Jahren erfindet ein ausgewanderter Bayer namens Levi Strauss die wohl berühmteste Hose der Welt -zunächst als Arbeitskleidung für kalifornische Goldwäscher.

programme.title: Himba, Buschmänner und Löwen - Wildnis- und Kulturmarketing in Namibia
programme.desc: Ein Reisebus nähert sich dem San-Dorf Grashoek in Namibia. Ein Schild begrüßt die Besucher im Bushman Living Museum. Noch im Bus beginnen die Insassen zu fotografieren.

programme.title: Gabun - Der Schatz im Regenwald
programme.desc: Anhand der politischen und ökonomischen Naturschutz-Initiativen zeigt Regisseur Werner Zips auf, dass der Kampf gegen den globalen Klimawandel und die Ausrottung von Tierarten im Kleinen beginnt.

programme.title: Juwel der Elefantenküste - Afrikas Wunderland Isimangaliso
programme.desc: 3280 Quadratkilometer am Meer mit Elefanten, Nashörnern, Büffeln, Löwen und Leoparden: der südafrikanische iSimangaliso Wetland Park. iSimangaliso heißt in der Sprache der Zulu Wunder.

programme.title: Die Magie des Leoparden
programme.desc: Die Magie des Leoparden lockt jährlich Hunderttausende Besucher aus aller Welt nach Südafrika. Der Safari-Tourismus floriert wie nie zuvor und sorgt für das Entstehen von Boomtowns.Viele Menschen leben zumindest indirekt von der Anziehungskraft der Wildnis. Die Dokumentation zeigt die Verbindungen zwischen Luxustourismus, Umwelt- und Wildtierschutz, sozialer Gerechtigkeit und Empowerment als Modell der afrikanischen Renaissance.Hinter der Fassade scheinbarer unberührter Wildnis aus den Reiseprospekten, Hotel-Broschüren und letztlich auch der Naturdokumentationen im Fernsehen stehen komplexe Management-Pläne, schwierige Verhandlungen zwischen alten Eignern und ansässigen lokalen Gemeinschaften sowie betriebswirtschaftliche Strategien der Verwertung von Natur und Kultur. Im Unterschied zu den meisten Tierdokumentationen stehen in diesem Film die Menschen und ihre Perspektiven auf den Nutzen von Naturschutz im Mittelpunkt. Dabei kommen von der deutschen Erbin eines berühmten Wildreservates bis zu Rangern und Hotelmanagern Beteiligte mit völlig unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen zu Wort.

programme.title: Im Reich der Königselefanten - Das Tembe Wildreservat in Südafrika
programme.desc: Das Tembe-Wildreservat gilt als Zufluchtsort der letzten Giganten: Elefantenbullen mit gewaltigen Stoßzähnen. Das 300 Quadratkilometer große Reservat wurde vom König der Tembe begründet.

programme.title: Natural World
programme.desc: Dr. Julian Fennessy hat Jahre seines Lebens der Erforschung von Giraffen gewidmet. Nun beginnt er, ihre Geheimnisse zu lüften - die wichtigste Erkenntnis ist, dass die Art bedroht ist.

Die Sendung informiert kompakt und verständlich über die wichtigsten Ereignisse im In- und Ausland und ordnet diese journalistisch ein. programme.title: Traumjobs: Von der Lehre an die Spitze
programme.desc: Vier namhafte Vorarlberger, die es mit einem Lehrabschluss in die Unternehmensführung und darüber hinausgeschafft haben: Stephanie Rist, Kerstin Palla, Udo Filzmaier und Rainer Ostermann.

programme.title: Gabun - Der Schatz im Regenwald
programme.desc: Anhand der politischen und ökonomischen Naturschutz-Initiativen zeigt Regisseur Werner Zips auf, dass der Kampf gegen den globalen Klimawandel und die Ausrottung von Tierarten im Kleinen beginnt.

programme.title: Juwel der Elefantenküste - Afrikas Wunderland Isimangaliso
programme.desc: 3280 Quadratkilometer am Meer mit Elefanten, Nashörnern, Büffeln, Löwen und Leoparden: der südafrikanische iSimangaliso Wetland Park. iSimangaliso heißt in der Sprache der Zulu Wunder.

programme.title: Die Magie des Leoparden
programme.desc: Die Magie des Leoparden lockt jährlich Hunderttausende Besucher aus aller Welt nach Südafrika. Der Safari-Tourismus floriert wie nie zuvor und sorgt für das Entstehen von Boomtowns.Viele Menschen leben zumindest indirekt von der Anziehungskraft der Wildnis. Die Dokumentation zeigt die Verbindungen zwischen Luxustourismus, Umwelt- und Wildtierschutz, sozialer Gerechtigkeit und Empowerment als Modell der afrikanischen Renaissance.Hinter der Fassade scheinbarer unberührter Wildnis aus den Reiseprospekten, Hotel-Broschüren und letztlich auch der Naturdokumentationen im Fernsehen stehen komplexe Management-Pläne, schwierige Verhandlungen zwischen alten Eignern und ansässigen lokalen Gemeinschaften sowie betriebswirtschaftliche Strategien der Verwertung von Natur und Kultur. Im Unterschied zu den meisten Tierdokumentationen stehen in diesem Film die Menschen und ihre Perspektiven auf den Nutzen von Naturschutz im Mittelpunkt. Dabei kommen von der deutschen Erbin eines berühmten Wildreservates bis zu Rangern und Hotelmanagern Beteiligte mit völlig unterschiedlichen Erfahrungen zu Wort.

programme.title: Himba, Buschmänner und Löwen - Wildnis- und Kulturmarketing in Namibia
programme.desc: Ein Reisebus nähert sich dem San-Dorf Grashoek in Namibia. Ein Schild begrüßt die Besucher im Bushman Living Museum. Noch im Bus beginnen die Insassen zu fotografieren.

programme.title: Phinda - Land der Geparde
programme.desc: Das Wildreservat Phinda in der südafrikanischen Provinz KwaZulu-Natal gilt als eine wahre Drehscheibe für die Wiederansiedlung für Geparden in Südafrika.

programme.title: Namibia - Das Geheimnis der Feenkreise
programme.desc: Namibia hat viele bekannte landschaftliche Attraktionen: die Etosha-Pfanne, die Skelettküste, das Diamantensperrgebiet, die Wüsten Kalahari und Namib.Doch das Land im Südwesten Afrikas birgt auch ein unerklärliches Phänomen: die Feenkreise - kreisförmige Kahlstellen inmitten von Grasflächen, die von einem Grasring umgeben sind. Woher kommen diese mysteriösen Kreise?In der Dokumentation begibt sich der Diplom-Biologe Norbert Jürgens von der Universität Hamburg, der seit mehr als drei Jahrzehnten die Pflanzenwelt im südlichen Afrika studiert, auf eine spannende Forschungsfahrt, um das Geheimnis der Feenkreise zu lüften.

programme.title: Edinburgh - die Perle Schottlands
programme.desc: Edinburgh hat einiges zu bieten: Die Stadt ist die Heimat von Harry Potter, birgt geheimnisvolle Unterwelten und bietet wagemutigen Fahrradkünstlern Sprungschanzen.Außerdem gilt sie als Hauptstadt der Piping-Welt. Nicht nur das schätzt Nils Michael, ein deutscher Dudelsackspieler von Weltniveau. Er schwärmt auch von den Kulturfestivals und der Schönheit Edinburghs. Immerhin zählt sie zum UNESCO-Weltkulturerbe.Danny MacAskill, ein Trial-Biker und YouTube-Star, hat seine Karriere in Edinburgh begonnen und ist dort schon einmal von der berühmtesten Burg Schottlands gesprungen. J.K. Rowling hat hier die Geschichte ihres Zauberlehrlings geschrieben, und täglich pilgern Fans zu den Orten, an denen sich die Autorin ihre Inspirationen holte. Victoria Street etwa soll Vorbild für Diagon Alley gewesen sein, der Straße, in der Harry Potter seine Zauberutensilien kaufte. Wer sich für Geschichte interessiert, wagt einen Blick in die Unterwelt. Unter der Royal Mile, der zentralen Straße in Edinburghs mittelalterlicher Altstadt, verbirgt sich Mary King's Close. Einst war sie eine der typischen Gassen der Stadt, in der die Menschen lebten, arbeiteten oder auch starben, besonders, wenn in Edinburgh eine Pest-Epidemie wütete. Dann wurde Mary King's Close überbaut und vom Sonnenlicht abgeschnitten. Heute kann man Führungen in die gut erhaltene Gasse machen und in die Geschichte der Menschen von damals eintauchen.
